source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
	ACID
	,BEGIN_CHQ_NUM
	,REC_TYPE
	,SP_SRL_NUM
	,BANK_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(VALID_FROM, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS VALID_FROM
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(VALID_TO, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS VALID_TO
	,INSTRUCTION_MODE
	,AUTO_RENEWAL
	,NUM_OF_RENEWALS
	,IS_EXPIRED
	,ENTITY_CRE_FLG
	,DEL_FLG
	,RCRE_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS RCRE_TIME
	,LCHG_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS LCHG_TIME
	,TS_CNT
	,LINK_SRL_NUM
	,LINK_BEGIN_CHQ_NUM
	,LINK_END_CHQ_NUM
	,CHRG_COLL_FLG
	,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,CONVERT(DATE,[INSERT_DTTM]) AS INSERT_DTTM
 FROM d360.STG_DEP_STOPPAYMENTADDTNLTABLE
